component.name: Piano Practice Tracker
component.summary: Record, slice and annotate your piano practice over USB-MIDI

description.p: Piano Practice Tracker records your practice sessions from a digital piano over USB-MIDI, lets you slice the raw take into fragments and plays everything back through a SoundFont synthesizer. It works fully offline.

ul.li: Record from any MIDI port, with a built-in metronome and optional live monitoring
Slice the raw take into fragments or discard silences and mistakes
Play back takes and fragments with play, pause and seek
Anchor comments to exact moments of a fragment and write Markdown notes with images
Keep your data in a vault folder that any sync service can copy between computers
